about.title: About Me
about.p1: Hello! I'm Victor Hugo, a developer passionate about technology and innovation. Currently studying Computer Science at UFPR, I combine academic rigor with practical experience in software development.
about.p2: My journey in programming began with the curiosity to understand how things work. Today, I dedicate myself to creating systems that not only work but provide an exceptional experience for users.
about.p3: Beyond code, I am deeply interested in Artificial Intelligence and how it can be applied to solve real-world problems. I am always looking for new challenges and learning opportunities.
